##    
Introduction 
This document describes how to configure the Dialogflow CX Virtual Agent. 
## Prerequisites
### Requirements
Cisco recommends that you have knowledge of these topics:
  * Webex Contact Center (WxCC) 2.0
  * Webex Contact Center Adminstrator access to the tenant 
  * Google Dialogflow CX 


### Components Used
The information in this document is based on these software versions:
  * WxCC 2.0


The information in this document was created from the devices in a specific lab environment. All of the devices used in this document started with a cleared (default) configuration. If your network is live, ensure that you understand the potential impact of any command.
## Addresses and Credentials
  * [Webex Control Hub](https://admin.webex.com)
  * [Webex Contact Center Management Portal](https://portal-v2.wxcc-us1.cisco.com)
  * [Google Cloud Portal Console](https://console.cloud.google.com)
  * [Google Dialogflow CX](https://dialogflow.cloud.google.com/cx)


## Introduction to Webex Contact Center with Google CCAI 
The Webex Contact Center with Google CCAI is the integration that allows the use of Google Text-To-Speech, Natural Language Understanding and **Virtual Agent** technologies with Webex Contact Center.
**Dialogflow CX** is designed for building complex, multi-turn conversations that involve multiple steps and decision points. It provides tools for creating conversational flows, managing context, handling user intents and entities, and integrating with other applications. Think of conversations that have many turns and where you want to track the interaction content very deeply. These types of conversations typically happen on the phone line to a Contact Center where people ask all types of questions, and the **Virtual Agent** needs to listen in and provide the answers. It does not mean that you cannot build complex flow using Dialogflow Essentials, which is another version of Dialogflow, but you would need to use a lot of code around it to build a whole framework to achieve complicated logic. But with Dialogflow CX flow builder interface it is no longer the case as the graphical interface lets developers design and build conversational AI applications without requiring extensive coding skills.
Webex Contact Center now supports **Dialogflow CX** integration and using this article, you can configure and test the solution.
The integration requires you to do configuration in multiple portals: Google Cloud Platform and **Google Dialogflow CX** , Webex Control Hub, and Webex Contract Center.
## Provisioning
### Objectives
The objective of this section is to introduce you to Provisioning process which would require to obtain Google CCAI licence for Webex Contact Center.
### Introduction to Provisioning
For billing purposes, you need to provision Webex Contact Center with Google CCAI.
Google provides these APIs for integration of Dialogflow Virtual Agent and Text-to-Speech technologies:
  * Dialogflow API
  * Cloud Speech-to-Text API
  * Cloud Natural Language API
  * Cloud Text-to-Speech API


The usage of these APIs requires a billing account as APIs usage is not free. The process takes a couple of days, so you are not going to complete the Provisioning process in this section. For your information in the next screenshot, you can see the high-level diagram with the required steps to complete the **Provisioning**.
[![2023-12-23_22h22_46](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-00.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-00.png "2023-12-23_22h22_46")
If you would like to read more about the Provisioning process, refer to [Provision Google CCAI for WxCC.](https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact.html)
## Create Dialogflow CX Virtual Agent
### Objectives
This section describes how to navigate Dialogflow CX and Webex Control Hub portals to create a new agent and bind the agent to the Webex environment by creating a new **Contact Center AI Config**.
### Task 1. Create new Virtual Agent
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : The **Virtual Agent** in the Dialogflow CX is a conversational agent that can interact with users through natural language conversations. It can be designed and customized to handle a wide variety of tasks and use cases, including user support, sales, and lead generation. It can help businesses automate their user service and support operations, reduce response times, and improve user satisfaction.
Step 1. Log into Dialogflow CX portal using your user account and password. Select project CL2024AMS. (If you experience any difficulties with logging in please clear the catch and cookies on the browser you use.)
Step 2. Click **Create Agent**. Then select **Build your own**.
[![2023-12-23_22h25_09](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-01.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-01.png "2023-12-23_22h25_09")
Step 3. Provide the name for the new agent using this format:**{Your Name}_Virtual_Agent**. Select location global (**Global serving, data-at-rest in US**).
[![2023-12-23_22h27_26](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-02.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-02.png "2023-12-23_22h27_26")
### Task 2. Assign the agent that you created for the Conversational profile.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : A Dialogflow **Conversation profile** is a set of configuration settings that define the behavior of the virtual agent in a conversation with a user.
Step 1. On the left top corner click **Menu** icon.
[![2023-12-23_22h28_19](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-03.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-03.png "2023-12-23_22h28_19")
Step 2. From the **Menu** options, select **Agent Assist**.
[![2023-12-23_22h29_20](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-04.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-04.png "2023-12-23_22h29_20")
Step 3. In the next window click on the **Conversation profile** under the DATA section. Now create a new Conversation profile for your section.
[![2023-12-23_22h30_08](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-05.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-05.png "2023-12-23_22h30_08")
Step 4. Create the name for your **Conversation profile** using this format: **{Your Name}_Conversational_Profile** .
[![2023-12-23_22h30_56](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-06.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-06.png "2023-12-23_22h30_56")
Step 5. Scroll down and enable the virtual agent for this **Conversation profile**. Click on the **Agents** field and select the agent that you created in the previous task and then click **Create**.
[![2023-12-23_22h31_32](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-07.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-07.png "2023-12-23_22h31_32")
Step 6. Once the **Conversation profile** is created, copy the profile ID past it to a notepad, or just know that this is the place where you can get the **Conversation Profile ID** as you need it the Task 4 of this section when configuring the AI config in Webex Control Hub.
[![2023-12-23_22h32_10](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-08.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-08.png "2023-12-23_22h32_10")
### Task 3. Configure Google Contact Center AI connector
**(This Task is informational only)**
Log into [Webex Control Hub](https://admin.webex.com/) using your user account, select **Contact Center** service and open **Connectors**. You can see the **Google Contact Center AI** card. This connector is used specifically for Dialogflow CX agents. Only users with permissions to Cisco Project can create this connector. For security reasons, the users for this section do not have such permission so this connector is preconfigured for you. For the demo purposes Dialogflow-CX connector can be used. 
[![2023-12-23_22h32_59](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-09.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-09.png "2023-12-23_22h32_59")
### Task 4. Create Contact Center AI config
Step 1. In [Webex Control Hub](https://admin.webex.com/), go to the **Contact Center** service, select **Feature** , and click **New**.
[![2023-12-23_22h33_57](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-10.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-10.png "2023-12-23_22h33_57")
Step 2. On the next window, select **Contact Center AI Config**.
[![2023-12-23_22h34_37](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-11.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-11.png "2023-12-23_22h34_37")
Step 3. Give the name for the feature using this format:**{Your Name}_WxCC__Virtual_Agent**. Select Dialogflow CX as the **Google Contact Center AI Connector** and post the **Conversation profile** ID that you had previously in Task 2.
[![2023-12-23_22h35_31](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-12.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-12.png "2023-12-23_22h35_31")
Step 4. You can now see the **Feature** was created.
[![2023-12-23_22h36_12](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-13.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-13.png "2023-12-23_22h36_12")
## Configure Dialogflow CX Virtual Agent
### Objectives
This section describes how to configure the **Virtual Agent** to have a conversation with a caller and decide whether to send the call directly to the queue with human agents or collect estimate information and send the data to the **Analyzer** report.
In the next screenshot, you can see a functional diagram of the flow for this section.
[![2023-12-27_10h47_01](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-14.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-14.png "2023-12-27_10h47_01")
### Task 1. Navigate to Dialogflow CX Agent flow builder and customize the initial greeting.
Step 1. Log in to [Dialogflow CX](https://dialogflow.cloud.google.com/cx%20) portal using your user account and password. Select project **CL2024AMS**.
Step 2. Select the **Virtual Agent** that you created earlier.
[![2023-12-23_22h38_41](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-15.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-15.png "2023-12-23_22h38_41")
Step 3. In the Dialogflow CX builder click on the Start page.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : In Dialogflow CX, a page is a set of instructions that holds one or more related conversational turns. It represents a single step in a conversation flow, and it can contain various types of content, including text responses, prompts for user input, fulfillment actions, and more. Pages are connected together to create a conversation flow that guides the user through a conversation with the Dialogflow CX agent.
_[![2023-12-23_22h39_19](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-16.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-16.png "2023-12-23_22h39_19")_
Step 4. In the **Start** page click on **Default Welcome Intent Route**. On the right window, scroll down, delete all the default Agent responses, and click on the field to **Enter** agent dialog.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : A route is a mapping between an intent and a specific page or flow within a conversation. Routes define how a conversation can flow based on the user input and the intent that is matched.
[![2023-12-23_22h40_10](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-17.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-17.png "2023-12-23_22h40_10")
Step 5. Provide your customized message to let the caller know that they reached an organization that provides sales services of Webex Contact Center. You can type something like: Hello! Thank you for calling. Here you know all about Webex Contact Center. In Dialogflow CX, the changes are not saved automatically, so you need to save the page every time you make a change.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : Agent responses are the messages or actions that an agent sends back to the user or caller during a conversation. When a user or caller sends a message or makes a request to a Dialogflow CX agent, the agent analyses the input and determines the appropriate response to send back.
_[![2023-12-23_22h40_56](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-18.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-18.png "2023-12-23_22h40_56")_
Step 6. Test the agent response that you just created. Click **Test Agent** and type a greeting message such as Hello.
[![2023-12-23_22h44_11](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-19.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-19.png "2023-12-23_22h44_11")
### Task 2. Create new page to collect the caller name
Step 1. Close the **Start** page and **Test Agent** windows and click the plus icon (**+**) to create a new page. Name the page **Caller_Name** and confirm the creation.
[![2023-12-23_22h46_25](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-20.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-20.png "2023-12-23_22h46_25")
Step 2. Connect the **Start** page and **Caller_Name** page. For this, click the **Default Welcome Intent** route on the **Start** page. Scroll down on the right side and select that you would like the conversation to go to the next page.
[![2023-12-23_22h47_09](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-21.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-21.png "2023-12-23_22h47_09")
Step 3. From the drop-down list, select **Caller_Name** page. Do not forget to **Save** the change.
[![2023-12-23_22h47_44](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-22.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-22.png "2023-12-23_22h47_44")
Step 4. Configure the **Caller_Name** page to collect the name from the caller and store it in the parameter. In the **Caller_Name** page click **Entry Fulfillment** and type message in which you ask the caller name. Click **Add** and **Save** the change.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : **Entry Fulfillment** is needed to provide a message to the caller once the call is moved to a new page to let the caller know where they are in the conversation and set the right expectations.
[![2023-12-23_22h48_24](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-23.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-23.png "2023-12-23_22h48_24")
Step 5. While on the **Caller_Name** page, click on **Parameters** , type **Name** as the parameter’s name, select **`sys.any `**from the list of preconfigured Entities, and click on**Save**.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : A **Parameter** is a named entity or value that is extracted from user input during a conversation. Parameters can be used to store information that is relevant to the user request, such as their name, date of birth, or preferred language. Parameters can also be used to pass data to other parts of your application such as Contact Center.
[![2023-12-23_22h49_33](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-24.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-24.png "2023-12-23_22h49_33")
Step 6. Configure **Routes** in the **Caller_Name** page. Click **Route** , on the right window scroll down to **Condition** and set the condition **`$page.params.status ="FINAL"`**. Click**Save**. By setting this condition, you can expect the call to move to the next page once the **Name** parameter which you created in the previous step is filled with a value. For example, if the caller says Nick then the call can move forward. 
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : A **Condition** in the Dialogflow Routes configuration is a rule or set of rules that define when the route must be triggered. The **Condition** can be based on various factors such as user input, context, parameters, and session data.
[![2023-12-23_22h50_16](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-25.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-25.png "2023-12-23_22h50_16")
Step 7. Using the **Test Agent** option on the right top side, test if the flow is working as designed at this point.
[![2023-12-23_22h51_16](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-26.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-26.png "2023-12-23_22h51_16")
### Task 3. Create new page Agent_or_Estimate and connect it with the Caller_Name page.
Step 1. On the left bottom side, click to add a new page, name it **Agent_or_Estimate** , and confirm the creation.
[![2023-12-23_22h52_03](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-27.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-27.png "2023-12-23_22h52_03")
Step 2. Connect **Caller_Name** and **Agent_or_Estimate** pages. Open the **Caller_Name** page, and select the route that you created in the previous step, on the right side scroll down and select the page **Agent_or_Estimate**. Do not forget to **Save** the change.
Remember in Task 2 of this section you configured the condition that once the parameter is filled it triggers an action. By selecting the next page you specify what action it is, in this example the call moves to the page **Agent_or_Estimate**.
[![2023-12-23_22h52_45](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-28.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-28.png "2023-12-23_22h52_45")
Step 3. Configure **Entry Fulfillment** for **Agent_or_Estimate** page. Open up **Agent_or_Estimate** page, and click **Entry Fulfillment**. In the Agent response type: Hi $session.params.Name, please let me know if you would like to speak with an agent or if you would to create an estimate?
Do not forget to **Save** the change.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : If you cannot copy and paste the suggested fulfillment just start typing in the **Agent Response** field, then you can paste the text, then delete unnecessary text.
[![2023-12-23_22h54_20](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-29.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-29.png "2023-12-23_22h54_20")
Step 4. Test if the conversation flow is configured properly at this point. Click **Test Agent** and in the **Talk to Agent** field type Hello and then type your name.
[![2023-12-23_22h55_05](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-30.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-30.png "2023-12-23_22h55_05")
### Task 4. Configure Route in Agent_or_Estimate page to move the call to new page What_Kind_Of_Agent.
Step 1. Open up the **Agent_or_Estimate** page, click on **Create New Route** , and then click on **Create New Intent**.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : An intent is a mapping between what a user says or types and a specific action or response that the conversational agent can take. Intents help the agent understand the user request and determine the appropriate response or action to take.
[![2023-12-23_22h55_56](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-31.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-31.png "2023-12-23_22h55_56")
Step 2. Name the **Intent Agent_intent**. Provide 3-5 training phrases, something like agent, representative, escalate, real person. Do not forget to save the change of the page.
[![2023-12-23_22h56_39](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-32.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-32.png "2023-12-23_22h56_39")
Step 3. Create new page and name it **What_Kind_Of_Agent** .
[![2023-12-23_22h57_12](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-33.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-33.png "2023-12-23_22h57_12")
Step 4. Click on **Agent_or_Estimate** page. Add a new **Route** , select the **Intent**.
[![2023-12-23_22h57_50](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-34.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-34.png "2023-12-23_22h57_50")
Step 5. On the **Routes** settings scroll down and select action to move the call to the page **What_Kind_Of_Agent**.
[![2023-12-23_22h58_23](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-35.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-35.png "2023-12-23_22h58_23")
Step 6. For a better communication experience you need to add no-input-default **Event handlers** otherwise the system detects no input even before you have a chance to provide input. While on the **Agent_or_Estimate** page, click on **Add state handler** , select **Event handlers** , and click on **Apply**.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : An **Event handlers** is a type of intent that is triggered when a specific event occurs. For example, if the **Virtual Agent** does not receive any input or it does not recognize the input, the event handler is used to trigger no-input intent which helps to continue the conversation.
_[![2023-12-23_22h58_57](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-36.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-36.png "2023-12-23_22h58_57")_
Step 7. Click on **Add New Event handlers** , select from the **No-input default** list and save the change.
[![2023-12-23_22h59_34](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-37.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-37.png "2023-12-23_22h59_34")
### Task 5. Configure Route for Estimate branch and Connect Agent_or_Estimate to new page Estimate_Details
Step 1. Create **Estimate_Intent**. While on **Agent_or_Estimate** page click the plus icon (**+**) to add new **Route** and create new **Intent**.
[![2023-12-23_23h00_31](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-38.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-38.png "2023-12-23_23h00_31")
Step 2. Name the intent as **Estimate_Intent** and provide some training phrases. As for the training phrases you can add statements like estimate, price calculation, I need to know how much it cost. Save the intent.
[![2023-12-23_23h01_08](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-39.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-39.png "2023-12-23_23h01_08")
Step 3. Create new page with the name **Estimate_Details**. Connect **Agent_or_Estimate** and **Estimate_Details** pages when **Estimate_Intent** is triggered.
[![2023-12-23_23h01_43](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-40.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-40.png "2023-12-23_23h01_43")
Step 4. Click the **Agent_or_Estimate** page. Add new **Route** , and select the **Intent Estimate_Intent**.
[![2023-12-23_23h02_22](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-41.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-41.png "2023-12-23_23h02_22")
Step 5. Scroll a bit down and add the agent response that the caller hears once the **Estimate_Intent** is triggered. You can type something like, let me collect some information for the estimate.
[![2023-12-23_23h03_07](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-42.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-42.png "2023-12-23_23h03_07")
Step 6. Scroll all the way down and select the transaction to the page **Estimate_Details** once the intent is triggered. Save the page configuration.
[![2023-12-23_23h03_39](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-43.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-43.png "2023-12-23_23h03_39")
### Task 6. Configure Estimate_Details page with Parameters and Route
Step 1. Similar to how you created the **Parameter** for the caller name, create the **Parameter** for the number of agents which the caller needs the estimate for. Click on the **Estimate_Details** page, add the **Parameter** , name it **Number_of_agents** , and select from the list the standard **Entity** type **`sys.number`**. Do not forget to save the change.
[![2023-12-23_23h04_25](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-44.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-44.png "2023-12-23_23h04_25")
Step 2. Configure the **Entry Fulfillment** for the caller to understand what information the **Virtual Agent** is looking for. You can type something like, please let me know how many agents you are planning to have in your Contact Center.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : If you cannot copy and paste the suggested fulfillment just start typing in the **Agent Responses** field, then you can paste the text, then delete unnecessary text.
[![2023-12-23_23h04_55](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-45.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-45.png "2023-12-23_23h04_55")
Step 3. Select the condition which triggers the action on the **Estimate_Details** page. While on the **Estimate_details** page, click on add new **Route** , on the right window scroll down a bit and configure the condition `**$page.params.status =“FINAL”**`.
[![2023-12-23_23h05_26](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-46.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-46.png "2023-12-23_23h05_26")
Step 4. Scroll more down and add the **Virtual Agent** response. Type: I am putting together the estimate request details for `**$session.params.Number_of_agents**`agents.
[![2023-12-23_23h06_08](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-47.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-47.png "2023-12-23_23h06_08")
Step 5. Add dialogue option and select **Custom payload** from the list.
[![2023-12-25_11h32_46](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-48.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-48.png "2023-12-25_11h32_46")
Post this next syntax to the **Custom** **payload** section and save the configurations.

```
{  
  
  "Execute_Request": {  
  
    "Data": {  
  
      "Params": {  
  
        "Estimate_Agents_Count": "$session.params.Number_of_agents"  
  
      }  
  
    }  
  
  }  
  
}
```

[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : In JSON data format, a variable is a key-value pair that represents a property of an object. The key is a string that identifies the property, and the value is the data associated with the property.
The **Custom payload** contains the key **Estimate_Agents_Count** and the value is the **Parameter** `**$session.params.Number_of_agents**`. This**Parameter** is changed depending on the caller response.
[![2023-12-25_11h34_03](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-49.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-49.png "2023-12-25_11h34_03")
Step 6. Scroll more down on the **Route** section and set up **Transition** to **End Flow**.
[![2023-12-25_11h34_59](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-50.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-50.png "2023-12-25_11h34_59")
It terminates the session on the Dialogflow side and transfers the call to WxCC where it continues from the **Virtual Agent Handled** path.   
  

[![2023-12-25_11h35_26](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-51.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-51.png "2023-12-25_11h35_26")
Step 7. Test your **Virtual Agent** flow at this point.
[![2023-12-25_11h35_51](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-52.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-52.png "2023-12-25_11h35_51")
### Task 7. Configure Estimate_Details page with Routes.
Step 1. Create two additional intents, **TAC_Intent** and **Sales_Intent**. Click on **Manage** , select Intents from the **Resources** list, and then click on **Create**.
[![2023-12-25_11h36_35](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-53.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-53.png "2023-12-25_11h36_35")
Name the intent and provide some training phrases. For example, for **TAC_Intent** you can add the phrases like: TAC Engineer, Technical Support.
[![2023-12-25_11h37_10](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-54.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-54.png "2023-12-25_11h37_10")
For **Sales_Intent** you can specify something like Price, Sales, and so on.
[![2023-12-25_11h38_06](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-55.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-55.png "2023-12-25_11h38_06")
Step 2. Add **Route** for the TAC queue. Go back to the queue and click on the **What_Kind_Of_Agent** page. Then click on **Add New Route** and select the intent you created in the previous step for the TAC queue. Save the route settings.
[![2023-12-25_11h39_35](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-56.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-56.png "2023-12-25_11h39_35")
Step 3. Scroll down and add the agent response that the caller hears once the intent is triggered.
[![2023-12-25_11h40_34](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-57.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-57.png "2023-12-25_11h40_34")
Step 4. Add the dialog option to move the call to the live agent by selecting **Live agent handoff** .
[![2023-12-25_11h41_16](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-58.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-58.png "2023-12-25_11h41_16")
By selecting this option, the call moves out of the **Escalate** output of the **Virtual Agent V2** block in the flow builder.
[![2023-12-25_11h41_42](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-59.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-59.png "2023-12-25_11h41_42")
Step 5. In the **Live agent handoff** payload field, you can add the data in the JSON format which you can later parse in the WxCC flow. In this case, you need to add **Type_Of_Agent (TAC)**. **TAC** which helps you to make the routing decision to the correct queue in the flow.

```
{  
  
  "dialogflow.ccai.live-agent-escalation": {  
  
    "Type_Of_Agent": "TAC"  
  
  }  
  
}
```

[![2023-12-25_11h42_11](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-60.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-60.png "2023-12-25_11h42_11")
Step 6. End the flow on the Dialogflow side once the call is moved to the WxCC flow.
[![2023-12-25_11h42_47](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-61.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-61.png "2023-12-25_11h42_47")
Step 7. Do the same steps to configure the **Route** for the **Sales** queue. Click on **Add New Route**. Select **Sales_Intent** and save the **Route** settings.
[![2023-12-25_11h43_17](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-62.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-62.png "2023-12-25_11h43_17")
Step 8. Add the **Agent** response and **Live agent handoff** dialog option.
[![2023-12-25_11h43_53](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-63.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-63.png "2023-12-25_11h43_53")
Step 9. End the flow for this page once the intent is triggered and the call is moved to the WxCC flow.
[![2023-12-25_11h44_32](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-64.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-64.png "2023-12-25_11h44_32")
Step 10. Add the **Entry Fulfillment** to the **What_Kind_Of_Agent** page so the caller knows what kind of answer the **Virtual Agent** expects. Click on the **Entry Fulfillment** field and type, please let me if you would like to speak with a Technical Support Engineer or you would like to talk about sales.
[![2023-12-25_11h45_02](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-65.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-65.png "2023-12-25_11h45_02")
Step 11. Test your Virtual Agent.
## Configure Flow with Virtual Agent in Webex Contact Center Management Portal
### Objectives
In this section, you can see how to build flow in Webex Contact Center Flow Builder with the **Virtual Agent** block which moves the call to queue with live agents or to estimate branch where data about the number of agents for the estimate can be extracted and used for **Analyzer** report. 
### Task 1. Create new flow.
Step 1. In the Webex Contact Center Admin portal open up the **Routing Strategy Module** and **Create New Flow** entry window.
[![2023-12-25_11h45_58](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-66.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-66.png "2023-12-25_11h45_58")
Step 2. Call the flow **`{Your Name}_Virtual_Agent_Flow`**.
[![2023-12-25_11h46_25](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-67.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-67.png "2023-12-25_11h46_25")
### Task 2. Configured Handled path to extract estimate data for the Analyzer report.
Step 1. Move the **Virtual Agent V2** to the flow and connect it with the **NewPhoneContact** block.
[![2023-12-25_11h46_58](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-68.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-68.png "2023-12-25_11h46_58")
Step 2. Click on **Virtual Agent V2** block and under the block settings select **Contact Center AI Config** which you created earlier or use the preconfigured **Virtual Agent** **`Dan_User1_Virtual_Agent`**. Also, click**Advanced Settings** and increase the **Termination Delay** time from 3 to 5 seconds.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : **Termination Delay** is the time range that must be set to allow completion of the audio prompt from the **Virtual Agent** in Dialogflow before the contacts move to the Webex Contact Center. For example, if in Dialogflow VA config there is a long response before the call goes to **Live agent handoff** , it cuts the response not finished and the call moves to the queue.
[![2023-12-25_11h47_31](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-69.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-69.png "2023-12-25_11h47_31")
Step 3. (Informational only) Understand how the call-related data is moving from Dialogflow to Webex Contact Center.
When the conversation is transferred from Dialogflow to WxCC, it creates some output variable with data in JSON format which has been generated in the Dialogflow portal while the caller was interacting with the **Virtual Agent**. One of the output variables is **VirtualAgentV2.MetaData**. You can see it by clicking anywhere on the grey area in the **Flow Builder** and scroll down on the right window. This output variable contains the data you specified in the **Custom payload**.
[![2023-12-25_11h48_04](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-70.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-70.png "2023-12-25_11h48_04")
The goal here is to extract the information about how many agents the caller requested for the estimate. In the previous section, you have created the parameter with the name **Number_of_Agents**.
[![2023-12-25_11h48_43](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-71.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-71.png "2023-12-25_11h48_43")
And you configure the **Route** with **Custom payload** where once the parameter is filled, the value of the parameter is assigned to the key **Estimate_Agents_Count** and then the call is moved to WxCC side.
[![2023-12-25_11h49_14](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-72.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-72.png "2023-12-25_11h49_14")
Step 4. Configure **Virtual Agent Handled** path to extract the estimate data and associate it with **Global Variable**. By parsing JSON data from the **VirtualAgentV2_MetaData** variable you can extract the value of the **Number_of_Agents** parameter value and assign it to the new variable on the WxCC environment. You also want the variable to be reportable, so you need to use a **Global Variable**. While in WxCC flow builder, cick anywhere on the grey area, and on the right window click on **Add Global Variable**.
[![2023-12-25_11h49_48](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-73.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-73.png "2023-12-25_11h49_48")
The **Global Variable** **Estimate_Number_of_Agents** needs to be created earlier in the WxCC Admin Portal. Then you just need to select it and click Add. This makes this **Global Variable** available for you to use in your flow. 
[![2023-12-25_11h50_19](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-74.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-74.png "2023-12-25_11h50_19")
Step 5. Add the **Parse** node. In the **Parse** node select **VirtualAgentV2.MetaData** as the **Input Variable** , select from the list the **Global Variable** you added to the flow in the previous step as the **Output Variable** , and use this next string to parse the JSON data **`$.Params.Estimate_Agents_Count`**.
[![2023-12-25_11h50_52](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-75.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-75.png "2023-12-25_11h50_52")
Step. 6. Use the **Play Message** node to validate the result and notify the caller. Add the **Play Message** node, **Enable Text-to-Speech** feature, select the TTS connector and choose **Output Voice** from the list.
[![2023-12-25_11h51_27](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-76.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-76.png "2023-12-25_11h51_27")
Step 7. Add **Disconnect Contact** node. Then click in the **Play Message** again, and add this Text-to-Speech Message, in the TTS field type, thank you. The estimate request for **{{Estimate_Number_of_Agents}}** agents was created, and your team can reach out to you soon with the results.
Delete the **Audio File** option and publish the flow.
[![2023-12-25_11h51_58](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-77.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-77.png "2023-12-25_11h51_58")
### Task 3. Configured Escalated to move the call to the appropriate Queue with live agents.
Step 1. Create Flow variable and name it **Queue_Routing**.
[![2023-12-25_11h52_40](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-78.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-78.png "2023-12-25_11h52_40")
Step 2. Add the **Parse** node and configure it to assign the value of the **Type_Of_Agent** variable from Dialogflow to the **Queue_Routing** flow variable.
[![2023-12-25_11h53_14](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-79.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-79.png "2023-12-25_11h53_14")
Step 3 Add the **Case** node and configure it with the variable **Queue_Routing**. In the link, Description configure values **TAC** and **Sales** as these are two values you move from the **Dialogflow** portal.
[![2023-12-25_11h53_44](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-80.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-80.png "2023-12-25_11h53_44")
Step 4. Add **Play Message** nodes to verify the call goes to the TAC queue. Configure the **Play Message** node with TTS and type the text similar to this, Thank ou for waiting. The TAC engineer can be with you shortly.
[![2023-12-25_11h54_25](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-81.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-81.png "2023-12-25_11h54_25")
Step 5. Do the same for the **Sales** queue. Let the caller know that the call can be connected to the **Sales** agent shortly.
[![2023-12-25_11h55_03](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-82.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-82.png "2023-12-25_11h55_03")
  
Step 6. Add **Queue Contact** block and configure it with the **TAC_Queue**.
  
[![2023-12-25_11h55_36](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-83.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-83.png "2023-12-25_11h55_36")
Step 7. Add additional **Queue Contact** and configure it with the **Sales_Queue**.
[![2023-12-25_12h01_53](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-84.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-84.png "2023-12-25_12h01_53")
Step 8. Point **Default** output on the **Case** node to the **Play Message** related to the **Sales Queue**. Validate and click **Publish the Flow**.
  
[![2023-12-25_12h02_38](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-85.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-85.png "2023-12-25_12h02_38")
### Task 4. Add the flow to you Entry Point.
Step 1. Go to **Entry Points** and select your **Entry Point**. Click on three dots to edit the **Entry Point**.
[![2023-12-25_12h03_13](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-86.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-86.png "2023-12-25_12h03_13")
  
Step 2. Select the flow and other required fields and save the **Entry Point**.
[![2023-12-25_12h03_52](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-87.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-87.png "2023-12-25_12h03_52")
Step 3. Configure **Entry Point** mapping for your **Entry Point**.
[![2023-12-25_12h04_54](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-88.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221526-configure-dialogflow-cx-virutal-agent-88.png "2023-12-25_12h04_54")
### Task 5. Test your configurations. 
After all these configurations are completed, call the DN related to your **Entry Point** and test the integration.

##    
Introduction
This document describes the way to track a defect fix and deployment through Cisco Defect and Enhancement Tracking System (CDETS).
## Prerequisites
### Requirements
There are no specific requirements for this document.
### Components Used
This document is not restricted to specific software and hardware versions.
The information in this document was created from the devices in a specific lab environment. All of the devices used in this document started with a cleared (default) configuration. If your network is live, ensure that you understand the potential impact of any command.
## Tracking the Defect with the Defect ID 
**Step 1:** Navigate to [Bug Search Tool](https://bst.cisco.com/bugsearch?referring_site=shp&bt=custV&sb=anfr "Bug Search Tool") and enter the defect ID and select **Search**.  
  

[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : Only registered Cisco users can access internal Cisco tools and information.
  
[![BST Tool](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-00.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-00.png "BST Tool")  
  

##    
  

[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : Defect can be shared directly with the full link. Example: Cisco bug ID [CSCwi65732](https://tools.cisco.com/bugsearch/bug/CSCwi65732).
[![Bug Link](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-01.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-01.png "Bug Link")
**Step 2:** To get notifications regarding updates on the defect, select **Notifications** and enter the frequency and email ID. Then click **Submit Notifications**. 
[![Notifications](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-02.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-02.png "Notifications")
## Key Notifications to Track 
### Defect Status 
Once a defect is fixed, the defect **Status** is moved from **Open** to **Fixed**.**  
  
**
[![Defect Status](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-03.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-03.png "Defect Status")
### Defect Deployment
Once the defect is deployed to production data center (DC), the region its deployed in must be listed under **Known Fixed Releases**.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : Please find the Data Center description. Detailed description can be found here on [Data Locality in Webex Contact Center](https://help.webex.com/en-us/article/n0p6xa1/Data-Locality-in-Webex-Contact-Center "Data Locality in Webex Contact Center")  
  
ProdUS1: United States   
ProdANZ1: Australia   
ProdEU1: United Kingdom  
ProdEU2: Frankfurt  
ProdJP1: Japan   
ProdCA1: Canada 
[![Defect Deployment](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-04.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/221757-track-webex-contact-center-defect-04.png "Defect Deployment")

## Introduction
This document describes how to provision Google Contact Center Artificial Intelligence (CCAI) with Webex Contact Center (WxCC).
## Prerequisites
### Requirements
Cisco recommends that you have knowledge of these topics:
  * Google Contact Center Artificial Intelligence
  * Google Dialogflow
  * WxCC 2.0


### Components Used
The information in this document is based on these software versions:
  * WxCC 2.0
  * Google Dialogflow ES and CX


The information in this document was created from the devices in a specific lab environment. All of the devices used in this document started with a cleared (default) configuration. If your network is live, ensure that you understand the potential impact of any command.
## Background
Webex Contact Center customers can leverage Virtual Assist and Conversational Interactive Voice Response (IVR) capabilities powered by Google CCAI. Virtual Agent Voice (VAV) is a feature which is part of the Cisco Contact Center portfolio.
This document outlines the steps partners or customers need to do in order to enable Google CCAI services procured through Cisco and provision it to work with Cisco Contact Center Solution.
## Provision
This workflow indicates the steps required to provision CCAI for Cisco partners:
[![PS1](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-00.jpeg)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-00.jpeg "PS1")
The steps for the successful provision of CCAI are outlined here:
Step 1. Place the order on Cisco Commerce Portal (CCW).
Partners or customers can log in to the CCW with their CCO ID and place the order for Google CCAI.
Step 2. Complete Control Hub Subscription. For more information see the section Control Hub Subscription.
Step 3. Create your Google Cloud Platform (GCP) account and GCP project (Customer's GCP project) where your CCAI applications are hosted.
**Note** : For details on how to create the GCP account and project, review these sections in this document: **Create a Google Account or GCP Account for Customers** and **Create a GCP Project.**
Step 4. Submit CCAI provision form.
Complete this provision form in order to obtain a CCAI account with Cisco: [Provision Form SmartSheet](https://app.smartsheet.com/b/form/5c705d899adf412692d74e0b2f16e810 "Provision Form SmartSheet")
Step 5. Associate the Cisco-provided service account with the customer's GCP project.
Once you receive the provision completion notification from Cisco, Cisco provides the service account that can be associated with your GCP account and can be integrated with your Contact Center Applications. This completes the Google CCAI provision process with Cisco.
**Note** : For details on how to associate the service account provided with your GCP account review the section **Associate the Service Account Provided by Cisco to the Customer's GCP Account** in this document. 
## Control Hub Subscription
When the CCW is completed an email is sent to the mailer provided during ordering. In general the email is sent to the the partner's email account.
This is an example of the email received with the order and the subscription id.
[![ramaya_0-1702483422481](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-01.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-01.png "ramaya_0-1702483422481")
Step 1. Click **Set up your service**.
Step 2. Select your Role. In this example the partner is selected.
[![Prov1](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-02.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-02.png "Prov1")
Step 3. Select if you or somebody else is going to setup the service.
[![Prov3](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-03.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-03.png "Prov3")
Step 4. Enter the user ID. The user should be the part of the organization and have Premium Agent, Full Admin role.
[![Prov4](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-04.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-04.png "Prov4")
Step 5. Review the information to make sure you are attaching the license to the correct organization.
  
[![Prov5](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-05.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-05.png "Prov5")
Step 6. Once the subscription ID provisioning is complete, you see the Subscription shows up in Control Hub.
[![Prov6](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-06.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-06.png "Prov6")
Step 7. Check subscription details on Cisco Sales Portal.
[![Prov7](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-07.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-07.png "Prov7")
## CCAI – Account & Project Terminology
GCP: The Google Cloud Platform is a provider of to compute resources to deploy and operate applications on the web.
GCP Project: GCP project consists of a set of users, a set of APIs (Application Programming Interface), billing, authentication, and monitoring settings for those APIs. This is where CCAI Applications is hosted.
The Cisco Service Account: The Cisco Project (Google calls it Partner Project) is a shell that is used to manage billing and generate authorization keys based on the service account linked to the customer’s GCP project.
## Create a Google Account or GCP Account for Customers
Customer’s Google account is required to create CCAI applications to use Dialogflow or Text-to-Speech or Speech-to-text or Agent Assist. For more information on how to set up your Google account, refer [HERE ](https://cloud.google.com/ "Google Coud").
For more information on how to create your Dialogflow application, refer [HERE](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/docs/ "Dialogflow") .
**Note** : Also, to obtain the key associated with the GCP service account, refer to: _cisco-ccai-onboarding@cisco.com_ or contact the Cisco CCAI onboard team.
## Create GCP Project
You can create your GCP project using your organization resources or using a Terraform tool.
**Note** : Contact your IT department in order to create the GCP project
## Associate the Service Account Provided by Cisco to the Customer's GCP Account
Step 1. Log in to the GCP Portal: [Google Cloud Console](https://cloud.google.com/ "https://cloud.google.com/").
Step 2. Navigate to **Console**.
Step 3. From the left navigation control pane, navigate to **IAM and Admin** and click **IAM**.
[![Provision7](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-08.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-08.png "Provision7")
Step 4. On the **IAM** page, click **Add Member**.
[![Provision8](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-09.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-09.png "Provision8")
Step 5. Add these details:
    1. **New Members** : Name of the service account provided by Cisco
    2. **Role** : Dialogflow API Admin


[![Provision9](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-10.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/217594-provision-google-ccai-with-webex-contact-10.png "Provision9")
Step 6. Click **Save**.
## Additional Information
The service account provided to CCAI customers by Cisco allows the customers to leverage these APIs to integrate with the CC applications:
  * Dialogflow API
  * Text-to-Speech API
  * Speech-to-Text API


### Cisco Visibility to Customer Data
Cisco does not have any visibility on Customer data or interaction messages between Contact Center and Google's Virtual Bot. Cisco only gets the data on utilization of API which can be used for billing.
###    
Cisco Bill and Other Google Cloud Services
As part of provisioning, Cisco only enables API's related to CVA and customers get service account to leverage those API's. This service account does not work with any other Google Cloud Services.   
Customers can still use their GCP Project to enable additional cloud services provided by Google and they are charged directly by Google from their own billing account.

## Introduction
This document describesthe steps to configure a compatible U-law wav files in Audacity before importing the file to Webex Contact Center.
## Prerequisites
### **Requirements:**
  * Webex Contact Center Administrator access to the tenant.
  * Audacity a recording application software (A free and open-source digital audio editor)


### Components Used
The information in this document is based on these software versions:
  * WxCC 2.0
  * Audacity 3.3.2


The information in this document was created from the devices in a specific lab environment. All of the devices used in this document started with a cleared (default) configuration. If your network is live, ensure that you understand the potential impact of any command.
[![note-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/note.gif "note-icon")
**Note** : This document is targeted towards customers and partners who have custom audio files to be played when end callers reach IVR prompts.
## **Problem Statement**
**The imported audio file in Routing Strategy - > Resources -> Audios Files is added in the flow but when the flow is pulled to play that audio wav file, the file does not play. Although the file is triggered.**
**Refer:** Imported an audio file: OUH_SD_Old_phone_number_removal.wav
[![image1](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-00.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-00.png "image1")
Used this Audio File on a PlayMusic node and published the flow and called in to check if the file plays. Could see the file is triggered in Debug but the wav file did not play as the caller did not hear any audio.
[![image2](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-01.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-01.png "image2")
## **Solution**
Webex Contact Center supports uploading .wav audio files with the specifications:
  1. Channels: 2
  2. Sample Rate: 8000
  3. Precision: 14-bit
  4. Bit Rate: 128k
  5. Sample Encoding: 8-bit u-law


### **Instructions to convert compatible audio files using Audacity recording application software.**
**Step 1:**
Open Audacity and -  _before importing the file_ - open preferences to change the project resolution settings.
[![image3](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-02.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-02.png "image3")
**Step 2:**
Change the project sample rate from the default 44,100Hz to 8000Hz, and the format from 32-bit float to 16-bit PCM.
[![image4](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-03.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-03.png "image4")
[![tip-icon](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/tip.gif)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/td/i/templates/tip.gif "tip-icon")
**Tip** : Now that the project sample rate is set correctly, import the provided audio file. Source format does not matter, Audacity is capable of handling a wide range of input and output formats, which is why it is useful here.
[![image5](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-04.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-04.png "image5")
**Step 3:**
Down mix the audio from stereo (two tracks, for two speakers) to mono (one track, for a handset single speaker).  
Click on the imported track and press **Ctrl+A** to select it. If the source audio is already mono, skip this step.
[![image6](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-05.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-05.png "image6")
**Step 4:**
Resample the new mono track down to the appropriate 8kHz. You need to press **Ctrl+A** again beforehand.
[![image7](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-06.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-06.png "image7")
**Step 5:**
You now have the appropriate number of tracks, and correct sampling rate. Time to export the track.
[![image8](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-07.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-07.png "image8")
**Step 6:**
Make sure the export format is **WAV (Microsoft)** and encoding profile is changed to **U-Law**.  
This is the most critical step as the formatting and encoding must be correct for the device to process it.
[![image9](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-08.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220878-converting-audio-files-compatible-to-web-08.png "image9")

##    
  
Introduction
This document describes the steps to configure a reportable global variable to capture the digits entered at a Menu node of a flow on analyzer. 
Contributed by Bhushan Suresh, Cisco TAC Engineer.  
  
  

## Prerequisites
### Requirements
Cisco recommends that you have knowledge of these topics:
  * Webex Contact Center (WxCC) 2.0
  * Webex Contact Center Adminstrator access to the tenant   
  
  



### Components Used
The information in this document is based on these software versions:
  * WxCC 2.0


The information in this document was created from the devices in a specific lab environment. All of the devices used in this document started with a cleared (default) configuration. If your network is live, ensure that you understand the potential impact of any command.
## Create a reportalble variable on WxCC portal 
**Step1:** Create a reportalble variable on WxCC portal under **Provsioning** > **Global Variables**
  
  
  
[![image1](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-00.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-00.png "image1")
##    
  

**Step 2:** Create a flow with a **Menu** node or edit an existing flow. Under **Global Variables** , the variable created on the Portal page populates here 
[![image2](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-01.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-01.png "image2")
**Step 3:** Create a **SetVariable** node after the Menu node and map the Global Variable created in the previsous step to the output variable (**DigitsEntered**) from the **Menu** node   
  
  

[![image3](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-02.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-02.png "image3")
## Verify 
Create a **Customer Session Record** (CSR) report on Analyzer and the gloabl variable created the previous step shows up as a profile variable
[![image4](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-03.png)](https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/support/docs/contact-center/webex-contact-center/220470-configure-a-reportable-global-variable-t-03.png "image4")
